$comment: Which jurisdictions the source watcher covers. Read by watcher/build_sources.py: every source (curated or cited in data/) for an excluded jurisdiction is left out of sources.json, so it is neither fetched nor reported, and its stored state is dropped on the next run. The data files and curated.json are untouched, so a jurisdiction comes back by deleting its line from 'excluded' and re-running build_sources.py.
rule: The watcher covers every jurisdiction that levies an income tax on wages or any local tax the engine applies to a paycheck, and federal. A state with a wage income tax can legislate or reissue its tables on any date; local governments change rates on any date. Left out: only jurisdictions with no wage income tax and no local wage or payroll tax (AK, FL, NH, NV, SD, TN, TX, WY) and territory minimum wage. Narrowing this list requires a documented reason, because the auto-update ledger (watcher/autoupdate-coverage.json) must account for every kept jurisdiction.

keep.AL: Municipal occupational taxes with dated rate changes (rateHistory in data/local/AL-municipalities-*.json, e.g. 2025-04-01).
keep.AR: HB 1001 / SB 1 (2026 fiscal session) cut the top rate retroactive to 2026-01-01 and DFA reissued the withholding formula mid-year (data/states/AR-2025.json).
keep.AZ: Employee-elected flat withholding rate (A-4); legislature can change it any session.
keep.CA: Per-period withholding tables and supplemental rates; FTB/EDD can reissue; local SDI and city payroll items.
keep.CO: Flat income tax rate is set by TABOR-linked triggers; local occupational privilege taxes (Aurora, Denver, Glendale, Greenwood Village, Sheridan).
keep.CT: Withholding tables (TPG-211) can be reissued after budget acts.
keep.DC: Bracket changes by budget act; DC Office of Tax and Revenue can reissue FR-230.
keep.DE: State withholding changes by statute; Wilmington city wage tax (local).
keep.GA: HB 463 cut the rate mid-2026; new withholding tables switch on 2026-05-11 (effectiveDateOfNewTable in data/states/GA-*.json).
keep.HI: Annual brackets by act; Tax Department publishes mid-year changes (Booklet A).
keep.IA: Flat-rate phase-down by statute (SF 2442) with annual rate notices; legislature can accelerate.
keep.ID: Idaho reissued its withholding tables on 2025-05-01 (HB 40, retroactive) and again on 2026-07-31 (effectiveDated in data/states/ID-*.json).
keep.IL: Flat rate and exemption amounts set by statute and IL-700-T; Chicago has no wage tax but local rules can change.
keep.IN: County income tax rate changes and a prior-table switch (rateChanges / priorTable in data/local/IN-counties-*.json, e.g. 2026-10-01).
keep.KS: Rates and tables changed by 2024 and 2025 acts; KDOR reissues Pub KW-100.
keep.KY: Local occupational license taxes change on city and county ordinance dates (12 dated rateChanges in data/local/KY-occupational-*.json).
keep.LA: Flat 3.09%-class rate and Block A deduction reset by Act 11 (2024 special session); LDR reissues R-1306.
keep.MA: Flat 5% plus 4% surtax threshold indexed annually; DOR bulletin changes mid-year.
keep.MD: State brackets and 23 county rates (counties can change them) plus July 1 provider switch.
keep.ME: Maine Revenue Services reissued its 2026 withholding tables in August 2026 (higher withholding standard deduction and a new 2% surcharge over $1,000,000 / $1,500,000, L.D. 2212), retroactive to January 1; the booklet was replaced at a new address (data/states/ME-2026.json effectiveDated).
keep.MI: City income taxes (24 cities) are set by city ordinance or vote, not on a fixed date; the registry is in data/local/MI-cities-*.json.
keep.MN: Brackets indexed yearly; Dept of Revenue publishes Withholding Tax Instructions revisions.
keep.MO: Rate cut triggers by statute; Kansas City and St. Louis earnings taxes (local).
keep.MS: Phased income tax cut by statute (HB 1 2023, 2025); MDOR reissues Pub 89-105 on any date.
keep.MT: Rates and tables changed by HB 337 (2023) and later acts; DOR reissues withholding tables.
keep.NC: Rate phase-down by statute each January, plus legislature may accelerate; NC-30 tables.
keep.ND: New rate structure by statute; Tax Commissioner can reissue withholding guide.
keep.NE: Rate phase-down (LB 754) with annual guide; mid-year legislative changes possible.
keep.NJ: Withholding tables NJ-WT; Newark payroll tax and local items; July 1 UI step.
keep.NM: Percentage-method tables by statute; July 1 workers comp fee step.
keep.NY: Withholding tables NYS-50-T; NYC and Yonkers local taxes can change.
keep.OH: HB 96's retroactive cut: October 1, 2025 and August 1, 2026 tables (midYearEffectiveDating), plus ~680 municipalities that start or change a tax on any date (Woodville, 2026-07-01).
keep.OK: Percentage method tables; OTC can reissue OW-2 on any date.
keep.OR: Bracket and subtraction phase-out tables OR-WR; TriMet and Lane Transit payroll taxes (local) change on July 1 or by district decision.
keep.PA: Local earned-income and local-services taxes: 2,600+ taxing bodies with dated rateChanges (data/local/PA-EIT-LST-*.json, e.g. 2025-04-01).
keep.RI: Brackets and supplemental rate by budget act.
keep.SC: Act 110 of 2026 (signed 2026-03-30) changed the income tax brackets retroactive to 2026-01-01, but SCDOR had not reissued its withholding formula as of 2026-10-18 (IL26-20); a revised WH-1603F can appear on any date (data/states/SC-2026.json knownGaps).
keep.US: Federal rules (IRS, DOL, SSA) can change at any time, and every state's cites to them hang off these.
keep.UT: HB 106 (2025) cut the rate retroactively; tables switch on 2025-06-01 and 2026-06-01 (midYearRateChange in data/states/UT-*.json).
keep.VA: July 1 withholding formula updates by Tax Department; legislature can change rates mid-session.
keep.VT: Withholding tables by act; Tax Department reissues BI-477 instructions.
keep.WA: No wage income tax, but Seattle payroll expense tax and other local payroll items can change.
keep.WI: Withholding tables and standard deduction phase-out; DOR reissues Pub W-166.
keep.WV: SB 392 took effect 2026-06-12, cutting every rate 5% retroactive to 1 January (effectiveDated in data/states/WV-*.json).

excluded.AK: No state income tax on wages.
excluded.AS: Territory minimum wage, which follows the federal schedule on fixed dates.
excluded.FL: No state income tax on wages.
excluded.NH: No wage income tax (interest and dividends only).
excluded.NV: No state income tax on wages.
excluded.SD: No state income tax on wages.
excluded.TN: No state income tax on wages or salaries.
excluded.TX: No state income tax on wages.
excluded.WY: No state income tax on wages.
